единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is a member of the Gemini series of natively multimodal reasoning models; it can comprehend input from text, images, audio and video, and generates image and text output in the response.
единицы.цитата: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is a member of the Gemini series of models, a suite of highly-capable, natively multimodal reasoning models. Gemini 3.1 Flash Image can comprehend input from different information sources, including text, images, audio and video. Image and text output is generated in the response.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image was evaluated with human evaluations of several quality aspects of image generation, using prompt sets in two categories: new capability sets and regression sets.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini 3.1 Flash Image was evaluated using the methodology below: 
Human evaluations of several different quality aspects of image generation were conducted. Prompt sets for human evaluations were in two broad categories:
единицы.раздел: Evaluation — Approach

единицы.утверждение_en: New capability sets are diverse text-to-image and editing evals covering text, style, character, reasoning, factuality, infographics, ink (doodle) based editing, multi-turn, and multi-image (multi-product recontextualization, multi-character, etc.).
единицы.цитата: New capability sets : diverse Text-to-Image (T2I) and editing evals are curated, covering a wide range of capabilities, e.g., text, style, character, reasoning, factuality, infographics, ink (doodle) based editing, multi-turn, multi-image (multi-product recontextualization, multi-character, etc.)
единицы.раздел: Evaluation — Approach
единицы.заметка: Косвенно перечисляет поддерживаемые классы задач: doodle-редактирование, мультиход, мульти-изображение, перенос нескольких товаров в новый контекст.

единицы.утверждение_en: Regression sets use popular use cases observed on Gemini 2.5 Flash Image and Gemini 3 Pro Image, to ensure Gemini 3.1 Flash Image shows no noticeable regression.
единицы.цитата: Regression sets : popular use cases observed on Gemini 2.5 Flash Image and Gemini 3 Pro Image, to ensure Gemini 3.1 Flash Image does not show noticeable regression.
единицы.раздел: Evaluation — Approach

единицы.утверждение_en: Benchmarked capabilities: T2I — General Text-to-Image, Text Rendering, Visual Design; Editing — General Image Editing, Stylization, Character Editing, Object/Environment Editing, Factuality, Infographics, Ink (doodle) based Editing, Multi-Image (Multi-Product Recontextualization, Multi-Character, etc.), Multi-Turn; public benchmark: a subset of GenExam.
единицы.цитата:
Capabilities / Benchmarks: 
T2I: General Text-to-Image, Text Rendering, Visual Design. 
Editing: General Image Editing, Stylization, Character Editing, Object/Environment Editing, Factuality, Infographics, Ink (doodle) based Editing, Multi-Image (Multi-Product Recontextualization, Multi-Character, etc.), Multi-Turn. 
Public benchmark: a subset of GenExam.
единицы.раздел: Evaluation — Capabilities / Benchmarks

единицы.утверждение_en: Evaluation methodology: side-by-side human eval for Elo across T2I, editing and multi-turn; single-sided expert rating on subject-focused EDU tasks (GenExam); AutoRater on factuality and style diversity of non-natural images.
единицы.цитата:
Eval Methodology 
SxS human eval to get Elo across diverse T2I, Editing, and Multi-Turn. 
Single sided expert rating on subject-focused tasks on EDU tasks, GenExam. 
AutoRater on factuality, style diversity of non-natural images.
единицы.раздел: Evaluation — Eval Methodology

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini's safety policies aim to prevent generating harmful content including CSAM and exploitation, hate speech, dangerous content, harassment, sexually explicit content, and medical advice contrary to scientific or medical consensus.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini’s safety policies are based on Google’s standard framework, which aim to prevent our Generative AI models from generating harmful content, including: 
Content related to child sexual abuse material and exploitation 
Hate speech (e.g. dehumanizing members of protected groups) 
Dangerous content (e.g. promoting suicide, or instructing in activities that could cause real-world harm) 
Harassment (e.g. encouraging violence against people) 
Sexually explicit content 
Medical advice that runs contrary to scientific or medical consensus
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Content Safety — Safety Policies
единицы.заметка: Категории, которые модель не должна генерировать; для генерации картинок — ориентир, что будет отклоняться.

единицы.утверждение_en: Google continues to refine automated safety evaluations to reduce false positives and negatives and updates query sets.
единицы.цитата: We continue to improve our internal evaluations, including refining automated evaluations to reduce false positives and negatives, as well as update query sets to ensure balance and maintain a high standard of results.
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Content Safety — Safety Policies
единицы.заметка: Признание, что автоматические оценки дают ложные срабатывания в обе стороны.

единицы.утверждение_en: Frontier safety was assessed on Gemini 3.1 Pro (most capable at publication), which did not reach any Critical Capability Levels; Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is expected to perform similarly and is considered unlikely to reach any CCLs.
единицы.цитата: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is part of the Gemini 3 family of models. We evaluated Gemini 3.1 Pro for frontier safety as it was the most generally capable model as of publication of this model card, and it did not reach any Critical Capability Levels (CCLs) outlined in our Frontier Safety Framework . Our assessments have shown that Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is likely to perform similarly to Gemini 3.1 Pro, therefore based on Gemini 3.1 Pro, we are confident that that Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is also unlikely to reach any CCLs. For more information, read the Gemini 3.1 Pro Model Card .

единицы.утверждение_en: Mitigations across the lifecycle include dataset filtering, conditional pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human and critic feedback, safety policies and desiderata, and product-level mitigations such as safety filtering.
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Content Safety — Risks and Mitigations
единицы.заметка: Про SynthID/C2PA в карточке ничего нет.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: The Thinking + Text Search + Image Search configuration scores above plain Gemini 3.1 Flash Image on every row except Creative editing (1023 vs 1031); the largest gain is on Infographics (Factuality): 1114 vs 1074.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Разности посчитаны по таблицам; на странице как вывод не сформулировано.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Gemini 3 Pro Image ('Nano Banana Pro') scores above both Gemini 3.1 Flash Image columns on Multi-Input (1-3) (1056) and Object/Environment Editing (1042) and ties the top on Stylization (1045), while Gemini 3.1 Flash Image leads Overall Preference and Visual Quality in text-to-image.

The card presents clear text for posters and localized text as intended uses while listing small text (often blurry in the 1k model), long paragraphs and page-length text as weak: in-image text works best short and prominent, and small text is a known risk at 1K output.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сведение двух разделов; рекомендация сформулирована мной из текста карточки.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: For edits, the card flags three failure modes to check for: partial instruction following and leftover ink in masked/doodle edits, occasional copy-paste of the input image, and left/right spatial confusion — so spatial instructions and doodle-based edits need verification.
Multi-input editing was benchmarked only for 1–3 input images ('Multi-Input (1-3)'); the card gives no maximum number of input images.
'4K' appears only as the image output token limit; the card does not state output resolutions, and the only resolution reference is the '1k model' in the text-rendering limitation.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Предостережение от смешения '4K token output' с разрешением 4K.

противоречия_внутри: E-166-1: модель 'can comprehend input… including text, images, audio and video', а E-166-3 (Inputs) перечисляет только текст и изображения.
Дата: 'Published 26 February 2026' и 'Published: February 2026' — согласованы, расхождения нет.
не_сказано: Нет поддерживаемых разрешений (1K/2K/4K) и соотношений сторон как параметров — только '4K token output' и '1k model'.
Нет максимального числа входных изображений (бенчмарк Multi-Input только 1–3).
Не объяснено, как включаются Thinking, Text Search и Image Search (только название колонки).
сомнения: Строки 3-249 (меню) побайтно совпадают с меню id165 — прочитаны при разборе id165, идентичность подтверждена diff.
По метаданным партии Known Limitations почти дословно совпадает с карточками id167 и id169 — сведение на следующем этапе.
